outcome: Efficacy of balloon tamponade in controlling PPH
cohort: The study included 134 patients who experienced postpartum hemorrhage.
finding: Condom balloon tamponade was found to be effective in 94.8% of patients in controlling postpartum hemorrhage and reducing blood loss.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery was spontaneous in 94% of patients and instrumental in 6% of patients, but the study does not report findings relating mode of birth to the efficacy of balloon tamponade.
country: N/A (GKMC Swabi is a hospital name, not a country)
cross-section timing: January 2023 to June 2023 (duration of the study period)
